manualReview.policyContamination: No text-question or 220-character host policy in the 14 parsed candidates; all 15 citations resolve to user-origin excerpts.

remainingIssues.evidence: A task-local request to first ask scheduling constraints became a general preference. Exact excerpt matching did not establish reusable scope.

Three cumulative reflections added 4, 5 and 5 candidates; paraphrases of the same buffer/format rules remain separate. Replaying identical proposals is idempotent; semantic merging is not implemented.
Despite a task-level one-paragraph exception, the answer used two paragraphs.
Answer said arrival must be before 10:25, then accepted arrival exactly 10:25 as a five-minute margin before 10:30.

manualReview.screeningCaveats: Literal format headings and omitted duration literals produce false failures; 11/13 in both arms is not a task success rate.

limits: One synthetic trajectory per arm; no independent blind review or repeated runs.
24 user turns and 3 reflections; user-rule activation still uses an explicit legacy remember string, not autonomous learning.
Final memory has one active mixed fact and 14 inactive candidates; typed atomization and legacy migration remain pending.
Memory-only gateway policy still rejects execute wrappers; no claim of MCP learning-channel validation.
